blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards to explore the waterways of downtown Providence and Lincoln Woods State Park. The Lincoln Woods location offers a peaceful freshwater setting with rocky shorelines and shaded trails suitable for beginners. The Providence location provides guided tours showcasing the city's architecture, bridges, and art from the water.
